Marta (CSM): Quick thread 1BR prep for Acme in 72 hours. Need owners: slide leads, short risk slide, demo owner, onboarding snapshot. Keep bullets short.
Priya (Onboarding): Ill take onboarding snapshot  ingest 81%, eval pass 89%, blockers: Okta attribute mapping + analytics RBAC.
Lenora (Solutions): Ill run the demo. 6-min flow (ingest -> query -> rerank) + perf p50/p95. Need demo key and sample bucket name. @Evan can you confirm dataset pointer?
Evan (Acme): Dataset: acme-catalog-q3. Execs want emphasis on uptime and predictable billing. They also asked for a 15-min pre-brief the day before.
Jordan (Product): Ill prepare roadmap + 1-slide ROI example (assumptions + ranges). Will keep cost figures as ranges only.
Amir (CS Dir): Renewal note: sponsor rotated; propose a "renewal runway" slide with sponsor map, health flags, and 3 asks (intro, cost review, pilot extension).
Marta (CSM): Action items: Priya (onboard slide) due EOD tomorrow; Lenora (demo steps + runbook) due in 24h; Jordan (roadmap+ROI) due tomorrow noon; Amir (renewal slide) draft by EOD. Evan confirm pre-brief time.
Evan (Acme): Pre-brief yes  schedule 2024-07-02 16:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Event created: Acme pre-brief  2024-07-02 16:00 UTC. Invites sent.
Priya (Onboarding): Okta metadata received. Minor issue: ACS URL uses internal alias; escalating to eng-infra, ETA 3-5h.
Lenora (Solutions): Demo runbook snippet for notes:
```n1) demo key: acme_demo_temp
2) ingest sample: s3://acme/acme-catalog-q3 -> ./sample
3) check: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}' 
expect p95 < 250ms
```
Marta (CSM): Please paste bullets into deck notes (link: https://docs.google.com/example). Rehearsal tomorrow 11:30 UTC. Short replies only.
Amir (CS Dir): Add appendix: SLA history last quarter (uptime, incidents, MTTR) for new sponsor context.
Marta (CSM): Thanks all  will post run-of-show after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
